features.text: Dynamic compression technology targets sore hamstrings, strained quads, and groin injuries while supporting active recovery
Performance-grade neoprene material maintains muscle warmth during activity, reducing risk of re-injury during intense training
Streamlined pull-on design ensures consistent compression throughout your workout or game, with no readjustment needed
Athletic fit allows full range of motion while providing therapeutic support for injured or fatigued muscles
Versatile support system works for both injury prevention and active recovery phases of training
